Felt Clinic (https://feltclinic.com) | Web Engineer | Remote (US Only) | Full-time | $180k-$200k

Felt Clinic is building the first embedded care SDK for health apps. Our mission is to make access to a doctor simple and secure inside any mobile application. We want teams to stop worrying about provider contracting and focus on building awesome experiences. We're looking for a NextJS Engineer to help us scale our platform. You’ll be developing powerful SDKs and APIs, integrating real-time communication tools, and shaping next-generation digital health experiences.

Tech Stack:

- Mobile: SwiftUI (iOS), Kotlin (Android), Ionic

- Web: Next.js, Turborepo, TypeScript

- Communication: WebRTC

What sets exceptional candidates apart:

- Hands-on experience working on mobile platforms (Swift/Kotlin)

- Expert with Next.js and RSC

- Stoked about healthcare experiences

- Deep expertise in full-stack product development

Felt has three name-brand Apps actively using our SDKs and anticipating approximately $10m ARR by late 2026. We’re backed by leading investors including 1984, Scrum Ventures, and Tau Ventures. Join us as we scale to build next-gen HealthKit on steroids.
